purpose: Soil carbon cost of planting soybean right after soybean. Decision (João, 2026-11-15): soybean on soybean may happen in the simulator, but it must be penalized in the soil. Read by the Python engine only; the team's page (analysis.js) does not use this file yet.
rule: While a soybean planted right after a soybean harvest is in the field, soil organic carbon (0-30 cm) changes at the crop's own rate minus this penalty. The penalty is drawn per trajectory, uniformly in [min, max], as the crop carbon deltas of soil-crop-response-hypotheses.json are.

penalty_mg_c_ha_year.meaning: Carbon a no-till soybean/wheat succession did not accrue, against the two rotations of the same experiment: winter crop rotation (min) and intensive crop rotation (max).
penalty_mg_c_ha_year.source: Campos, B.-H. C.; Amado, T. J. C.; Bayer, C.; Nicoloso, R. S.; Fiorin, J. E. 2011. Carbon stock and its compartments in a subtropical oxisol under long-term tillage and crop rotation systems. Revista Brasileira de Ciência do Solo 35(3): 805-817. doi:10.1590/S0100-06832011000300016
penalty_mg_c_ha_year.quote: Assuming the system CT R0 as base line, soil C sequestration rates ranged from 0 to 0.51 Mg ha-1 yr-1 C in the 0–0.30 m layer (Figure 4). This way, there was no C sequestration in the NT R0 system [...] the rates of soil C sequestration in these crop rotations were higher in untilled soil (0.29 and 0.51 Mg ha -1 yr -1 C, respectively).
penalty_mg_c_ha_year.treatments_quote: monoculture system (R0) – wheat (Triticum aestivum L.) /soybean (Glycine max (L.) Merrill); winter crop rotation (R1) – wheat/soybean/ black oat (Avena strigosa Schreb)/soybean
penalty_mg_c_ha_year.context: Long-term experiment set up in 1985 at FUNDACEP, Cruz Alta, Rio Grande do Sul; Red Oxisol (Latossolo Vermelho distrófico típico); 19 years; sampled in 2004.
penalty_mg_c_ha_year.gap: One experiment in a subtropical Oxisol of Rio Grande do Sul; transfer to Ariquemes, Franca and Varginha is a hypothesis. The monoculture of the study alternates soybean with wheat in winter, not soybean alone. No source yet for an effect of repeated soybean on total N.

conversion.formula: g/kg/year = penalty (Mg C/ha/year) × 1e6 g/Mg ÷ (0.30 m × 10,000 m²/ha × bulk density (kg/dm³) × 1000 kg/m³ per kg/dm³) = penalty × 0.3333 ÷ bulk density
